diagnosis: All four rollouts followed an identical, clean pattern: A1 opened, A2 revealed PF1, A3 revealed PF2, A4 revealed PF3, and A1 settled with all three facts credited and cited in justification_fact_ids. Provenance checks P1/P2/P3 passed 4/4 and content checks C1/C2/C3/C4 passed 4/4, confirming genuine disclosure and use. However, content checks C5, C6, and C7 failed in all four rollouts (0/4). Since PF1, PF2, and PF3 were explicitly revealed via reveal actions and cited in justification_fact_ids in every settlement, this is an ENCODING MISMATCH: the checks expect the settlement to encode the 'control' implications (facilities control requiring the panel offline, clinic control requiring generator-backed power, network control identifying synchronization) in a specific structured field or commitment format that the model does not produce. The model encodes these details only in free-text commitment 'detail' strings, not in the decision fields or commitment types the checks likely inspect.

C6.why: The vaccine refrigerator requirement changes the clinic transfer window to exactly 1000-1200 and changes the clinic control to require generator-backed power during that transfer.
